name: Suffocating Void
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 40-ft.-radius spread
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

When you cast this spell, you create an airless void zone. Creatures within the area of effect that breathe must hold their breath or immediately begin to suffocate.

Creatures that do not need to breathe are unaffected by suffocating void and can act normally, even with respect to verbal spell components.

This spell does not function underwater.
